notes.title: Injection π23 NNNN - Expansion Events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35548808/84347c00121b40d141b98bb4d3d765224f932788.png[/img]

Injection π23 'No Name, No Number' Expansion Events is released as a separate DLC. Includes the Halloween and Christmas expansions.

notes.title: Christmas event
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=nxTi7MzNsog;full][/previewyoutube]

From December 23 to January 7, chapter 8-III will be available for free and by update for all users of Injection π23 'No name, no number'.

You will travel to the big city to enter the shopping center 'El Rosal', abandoned in the middle of Christmas.

Players who manage to complete this chapter can access the beta of the second part, Injection π23 'Ars Regia'
